universities.name: Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology
universities.description: Ghana's premier science and technology university, known for engineering, medicine, and innovative research.
requirements: Pass WASSCE with Aggregate 12 or better
Minimum B3 in Core Mathematics, English, and Science
Minimum C6 in three elective subjects
universities.admission_info: Applications open in January. Deadline is March 31st. Visit the university website for detailed requirements.

universities.name: University of Ghana
universities.description: Ghana's oldest and largest university, offering comprehensive programs across all disciplines.
requirements: Pass WASSCE with Aggregate 14 or better
Minimum C6 in Core Mathematics, English, and Science
Minimum C6 in three elective subjects
universities.admission_info: Applications open in January. Deadline is March 31st. Check the UG admissions portal for updates.

universities.name: University of Mines and Technology
universities.description: Ghana's premier university for mining, geology, and engineering education.
requirements: Pass WASSCE with Aggregate 16 or better
Minimum C6 in Core Mathematics, English, and Science
Minimum C6 in three elective subjects
universities.admission_info: Applications open in January. Deadline is March 31st. Special consideration for female applicants.

universities.name: University of Cape Coast
universities.description: A leading university known for teacher training, arts, and social sciences education.
requirements: Pass WASSCE with Aggregate 15 or better
Minimum C6 in Core Mathematics, English, and Science
Minimum C6 in three elective subjects
universities.admission_info: Applications open in January. Deadline is March 31st. Teacher training programs have specific requirements.

universities.name: University of Lagos
universities.cutoff: UTME 200 (institutional minimum; most departments require more)
universities.description: Nigeria's premier university located in Lagos, renowned for medicine, law, business, and engineering.
requirements: JAMB UTME score of 200 or higher (departmental cutoffs are often higher)
Five WAEC/NECO credits including English Language and Mathematics, in no more than two sittings
Pass the UNILAG Post-UTME screening exercise
universities.admission_info: JAMB UTME registration typically opens January-February. Post-UTME screening follows after JAMB releases results. Check the UNILAG admissions portal for exact 2026/2027 dates.

universities.name: University of Ibadan
universities.cutoff: UTME 200 (institutional minimum; competitive courses require more)
universities.description: Nigeria's first university, established in 1948, known for strong programs in medicine, the sciences, and the humanities.
requirements: JAMB UTME score of 200 or higher (departmental cutoffs vary by faculty)
Five WAEC/NECO credits including English Language and Mathematics, in no more than two sittings
Pass the UI Post-UTME screening exercise
universities.admission_info: JAMB UTME registration typically opens January-February. Post-UTME screening and admission list release follow later in the year. Check the UI admissions portal for exact 2026/2027 dates.

universities.name: Obafemi Awolowo University
universities.cutoff: UTME 200 (Medicine and Surgery is highly competitive, typically 280+)
universities.description: A leading federal university known for its unified campus design, strong sciences, and highly competitive medicine programme.
requirements: JAMB UTME score of 200 or higher (Medicine and Surgery typically requires 280+)
Five WAEC/NECO credits including English Language and Mathematics, in no more than two sittings
Pass the OAU Post-UTME screening exercise
universities.admission_info: JAMB UTME registration typically opens January-February. Check the OAU admissions portal for exact 2026/2027 Post-UTME dates.

universities.name: University of Nigeria, Nsukka
universities.cutoff: UTME 160 (departmental cutoffs are higher - e.g. Medicine and Surgery around 314)
universities.description: Nigeria's first indigenous university, offering a broad range of programs including medicine, engineering, and agriculture.
requirements: JAMB UTME score of 160 or higher (institutional minimum; departmental cutoffs are set after Post-UTME)
Five WAEC/NECO credits including English Language and Mathematics, in no more than two sittings
Pass the UNN Post-UTME screening exercise
universities.admission_info: JAMB UTME registration typically opens January-February. Check the UNN admissions portal for exact 2026/2027 Post-UTME dates.

universities.name: Covenant University
universities.description: A leading private Christian university known for engineering, computer science, and business programs, with a strong focus on entrepreneurship.
requirements: JAMB UTME score of 150 or higher
Five WAEC/NECO credits including English Language and Mathematics, in no more than two sittings
Pass the Covenant University Post-UTME/aptitude screening
universities.admission_info: Applications open shortly after JAMB registration. As a private university, Covenant also runs its own Direct Entry and screening timelines - check the official admissions portal for 2026/2027 dates.
